name: com.amobear.ttmng
description:
Shared modules and editor tools for shipping Unity games as TikTok Mini Games: SDK bootstrap, storage, ads, desktop shortcut / sidebar revisit, share, safe area, network, vibrate (ads-only monetization), plus Setup, Validate and Build tools.

Bundles the TikTok Unity SDK com.tiktok.minigame 1.1.5-Release (TTSDK~/) and offers to import it into Assets/Plugins when missing.

samples.description: Setup scene (TikTokBootstrap), Shortcut / Sidebar Revisit / Share popups and an API test menu. Menu AmobearTTMNG/Demo/Add Demo Scenes to Build after import.
